name: Drawing His Eye
game_text: <phase>Fellowship</phase>: For each <culture>Gondor</culture> companion you spot, reveal 1 card at random from a Shadow player's hand. Choose a revealed Shadow card to be discarded, then its owner draws a card.
flavor_text: “‘We cannot achieve victory by arms, but by arms we can give the Ring-bearer his only chance, frail though it be.’”
